description: TypeScript projects using Node's built-in test runner should preserve their native command, asserted import evidence, and audit-first plan shape.

lockedFields.reason: The plan should preserve the package's TypeScript-aware Node test command.
An explicit Node test import, native script, and matching test location provide high-confidence setup evidence.
The untested external order boundary should remain one add-test candidate.
The parser's existing native test should be extended rather than duplicated.
The DTO-only interface should remain deferred from direct testing.
The asserted parser evidence should keep the existing test as the first review target.
Node assert usage should remain explicit in the plan provenance.
The untested service boundary should receive a new unit-test recommendation.
DTO-only TypeScript should not become a direct test target.

allowedVariations: Rationale wording may change while retaining the native Node test strategy.
Additional non-locked metadata may be added.
unexpectedVariations: Treating the Node test runner as unsupported.
Replacing the discovered npm test command.
Dropping asserted evidence for the parser test.
Generating a direct DTO test recommendation.
